summary: Projector’s terminal console lets you supervise agent sessions and answer their inbox items. This change gives the console a direct source-checkout launch command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m projector.console. You can try the checked-out code without replacing the installed projector command.

The installed command and the source module use one argument parser. Both retain setup for preparing the optional agent environment and open the existing managed console for ordinary launches. The separate human.py module and unused base-console startup code are removed.

cards.title: Two launch paths, one console
cards.html:
• Checkout: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m projector.console
  • Installed package: projector
  • Optional environment: add setup to either command.
  • Both ordinary launches require terminal input and output and reach the existing managed-session console.

groups.title: One console entry point
groups.kicker: Connect the package command and source module to the managed console.
intro: A Python entry point is the function an installed shell command calls. The package now sends projector to projector.console:main, the same module that Python executes for python -m projector.console. The parser accepts the existing optional setup command.

For an ordinary launch, main delegates to the existing project console handler. That handler checks terminal support and opens the managed console, so this relocation preserves session controls and delivery behavior. Setup still prepares the separate worker environment and reports its normal errors.

groups.title: Exercise and document source launches

intro: The terminal tests launch the console in a pseudo-terminal, a controlled terminal used by the test process. They now execute python -m projector.console, so the existing input, mouse, and shutdown regressions check the new source launch path directly.
Permission-rule tests parse human-interface commands with the relocated parser. The agent guide documents running the source module and its setup command without changing the installed executable.
